name: Project Zomboid
tagline: Java agent that connects a Project Zomboid Build 42 dedicated server to Takaro.
requirements: Ability to set JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS or edit vmArgs

assets.label: Connector
assets.hint: Unzip into <Zomboid data dir>/ so Takaro/TakaroConnector.jar and Takaro/TakaroConfig.txt land there, paste the registration token into TakaroConfig.txt, then load the jar with -javaagent:.

assets.label: Jar only (upgrades)
assets.hint: To upgrade, replace Takaro/TakaroConnector.jar with this file, renamed to TakaroConnector.jar.
